entries.question: What does being a Gold member get me in terms of returns and shipping?
entries.answer: As a Gold member, you get 45-day returns and free Express shipping on every order [S1] and [S3]. The return window is counted from the date the carrier marks the package as delivered, not from the date you ordered [S2].

entries.question: I'm a Gold member and my keyboard has dead keys after 50 days. Am I covered?
entries.answer: You can return most items within 30 days of the delivery date. Gold members have 45 days [S3]. However, the warranty covers manufacturing defects such as switches that stop registering on the keyboard [S1]. If your keyboard has dead keys after 50 days, it may be considered a warranty case if it is due to a manufacturing defect. If it is not covered under warranty, you might be eligible for a 15% discount code for buying a new keyboard [S4].

entries.question: I'm a Gold member in Canada. Do I get free express shipping on my order, and what's my return window?
entries.answer: Yes, as a Gold member in Canada, you get free Express shipping on your order [S2]. Your return window is 45 days from the date the carrier marks the package as delivered [S3]. Note that free-shipping thresholds and the Gold or Premium shipping perks do not apply to international orders [S4].

entries.question: My mouse stopped working after 13 months. Is it still under warranty, and can I still return it if I bought it 20 days ago as a Standard customer?
entries.answer: The Nimbus Glide Wireless Mouse (PRD-001) has a 1-year warranty [S5]. Since the mouse stopped working after 13 months, it is no longer under warranty. However, you can still claim a warranty repair if the product is still under warranty. Since the mouse is out of warranty, you can email support with your order ID and photos or a short video showing the problem. We reply within 2 business days. For the mouse, we cannot repair it and will email you a 15% discount code for buying a new one [S3]. As a Standard customer, you can return it if it is within the return window, but the warranty claim is not limited by the return window [S2].

entries.question: I received my keyboard as a gift and some keys don't work. Can I get it repaired, and do I need anything from the original buyer?
entries.answer: Yes, you can get your keyboard repaired if the issue is covered under the warranty. The warranty covers manufacturing defects such as switches or keys that stop registering [S5]. Since you received the keyboard as a gift, the warranty coverage stays with the product, but you will need the original order ID to make a claim [S4]. You do not need anything from the original buyer, but you should have the original order ID ready when contacting support.

entries.question: I'm a Premium member and I was charged twice for one order. How long until I get the extra charge refunded?
entries.answer: If you're a Premium member and you were charged twice for one order, the extra charge will be refunded within 5 business days after you contact support with the order ID [S1].

entries.question: How long do I have?
entries.answer:
The time you have depends on the context of your query:

- For returns, you can return most items within 30 days of the delivery date. Gold members have 45 days and Premium members have 60 days [S4].
- For warranty claims, there is no time limit, and you can claim long after 30 days as long as the product is still under warranty [S3].
- For a replacement unit warranty, it is covered for the rest of the original warranty period, or for 90 days from the day you receive it, whichever is longer [S1].
- For a battery included in the box, the warranty is for 6 months only [S2].
- For account deletion, the process is completed within 30 days, but order and invoice records are kept for 7 years [S5].

entries.question: Can I get my money back?
entries.answer: Yes, you can get your money back under certain conditions. If you cancel your order before it ships, the refund will arrive within 3 business days [S2]. If you return an item, the refund will be issued once the item is received and inspected, and it will include the original shipping cost unless the return is for a refused delivery, in which case the refund is issued after the package returns to our warehouse, minus the original shipping cost [S3]. However, items that cannot be returned, such as gift cards, engraved or custom keyboards, and products with a removed or damaged serial number, are not eligible for a refund [S1]. If the return is after the return window, it may still be covered by the warranty if it is defective [S1].
